features.source:
def feature(s):
    sites = s.get('sites', ())
    n = len(sites)
    if n == 0:
        return 0.0
    props = s.get('element_properties', {})
    radii = [props.get(t.get('element'), {}).get('covalent_radius_A') for t in sites]
    occ = [max(0.0, float(t.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0)) for t in sites]
    nearest = [math.inf] * n
    neighbors = s.get('neighbors', ())
    for b in neighbors:
        d = b.get('distance_A')
        if d is not None and d > 0.0 and math.isfinite(d):
            i = b['i']
            if d < nearest[i]:
                nearest[i] = d
    total = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    for b in neighbors:
        d = b.get('distance_A')
        i = b['i']
        j = b['j']
        if d is None or d <= 0.0 or not math.isfinite(d) or d > 1.25 * nearest[i]:
            continue
        ri = radii[i]
        rj = radii[j]
        if ri is None or rj is None or not math.isfinite(ri) or not math.isfinite(rj) or ri <= 0.0 or rj <= 0.0:
            continue
        w = occ[i] * occ[j]
        total += w * d / (ri + rj)
        weight += w
    return float(total / weight) if weight > 0.0 else 0.0

def feature(s):
    sites = s.get('sites', ())
    n = len(sites)
    if n == 0:
        return 0.0
    occ = [max(0.0, float(t.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0)) for t in sites]
    nearest = [math.inf] * n
    neighbors = s.get('neighbors', ())
    for b in neighbors:
        d = b.get('distance_A')
        if d is not None and d > 0.0 and math.isfinite(d):
            i = b['i']
            if d < nearest[i]:
                nearest[i] = d
    weights = [0.0] * n
    first = [0.0] * n
    second = [0.0] * n
    for b in neighbors:
        d = b.get('distance_A')
        i = b['i']
        if d is not None and d > 0.0 and math.isfinite(d) and d <= 1.25 * nearest[i]:
            w = occ[b['j']]
            weights[i] += w
            first[i] += w * d
            second[i] += w * d * d
    total = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        if weights[i] > 0.0 and first[i] > 0.0:
            mean = first[i] / weights[i]
            cv = math.sqrt(max(0.0, second[i] / weights[i] - mean * mean)) / mean
            total += occ[i] * cv
            weight += occ[i]
    return float(total / weight) if weight > 0.0 else 0.0

features.description: Mean donor ionization energy minus acceptor electron affinity on first-shell contacts, weighted by occupancy and inverse distance; the lower-electronegativity element is the donor.
features.name: first_shell_atomic_charge_transfer_gap_eV
features.source:
def feature(s):
    sites = s.get('sites', ())
    n = len(sites)
    if n == 0:
        return 0.0
    props = s.get('element_properties', {})
    records = [props.get(t.get('element'), {}) for t in sites]
    chi = [p.get('eneg') for p in records]
    occ = [max(0.0, float(t.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0)) for t in sites]
    nearest = [math.inf] * n
    neighbors = s.get('neighbors', ())
    for b in neighbors:
        d = b.get('distance_A')
        if d is not None and d > 0.0 and math.isfinite(d):
            i = b['i']
            if d < nearest[i]:
                nearest[i] = d
    total = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    for b in neighbors:
        d = b.get('distance_A')
        i = b['i']
        j = b['j']
        if d is None or d <= 0.0 or not math.isfinite(d) or d > 1.25 * nearest[i]:
            continue
        a = chi[i]
        c = chi[j]
        if a is None or c is None or not math.isfinite(a) or not math.isfinite(c) or a == c:
            continue
        donor = i if a < c else j
        acceptor = j if a < c else i
        ionization = records[donor].get('first_ionization_energy_eV')
        affinity = records[acceptor].get('electron_affinity_eV')
        if ionization is None or affinity is None or not math.isfinite(ionization) or not math.isfinite(affinity):
            continue
        w = occ[i] * occ[j] / d
        total += w * (ionization - affinity)
        weight += w
    return float(total / weight) if weight > 0.0 else 0.0

features.description: Composition-weighted mean atomic chemical hardness, (first ionization energy minus electron affinity)/2, using available elemental values.
features.name: mean_atomic_chemical_hardness_eV
features.source:
def feature(s):
    props = s.get('element_properties', {})
    total = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    for e, x in s.get('composition', {}).items():
        if x is None or x <= 0.0 or not math.isfinite(x):
            continue
        p = props.get(e, {})
        ionization = p.get('first_ionization_energy_eV')
        affinity = p.get('electron_affinity_eV')
        if ionization is None or affinity is None or not math.isfinite(ionization) or not math.isfinite(affinity):
            continue
        total += x * 0.5 * (ionization - affinity)
        weight += x
    return float(total / weight) if weight > 0.0 else 0.0

features.description: Mean rotationally invariant anisotropy of each first-shell bond-direction second-moment tensor: zero for isotropic environments and one for collinear environments.
features.name: local_bond_fabric_anisotropy
features.source:
def feature(s):
    sites = s.get('sites', ())
    n = len(sites)
    matrix = s.get('lattice', {}).get('matrix')
    if n == 0 or matrix is None or len(matrix) != 3:
        return 0.0
    lattice = np.asarray(matrix, dtype=float)
    occ = [max(0.0, float(t.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0)) for t in sites]
    nearest = [math.inf] * n
    neighbors = s.get('neighbors', ())
    for b in neighbors:
        d = b.get('distance_A')
        if d is not None and d > 0.0 and math.isfinite(d):
            i = b['i']
            if d < nearest[i]:
                nearest[i] = d
    tensors = np.zeros((n, 3, 3))
    weights = [0.0] * n
    for b in neighbors:
        d = b.get('distance_A')
        i = b['i']
        j = b['j']
        if d is None or d <= 0.0 or not math.isfinite(d) or d > 1.25 * nearest[i] or occ[j] <= 0.0:
            continue
        fi = sites[i]['frac_coords']
        fj = sites[j]['frac_coords']
        image = b['image']
        delta = np.asarray([fj[k] + image[k] - fi[k] for k in range(3)], dtype=float)
        u = np.dot(delta, lattice)
        length = float(np.linalg.norm(u))
        if length <= 0.0 or not math.isfinite(length):
            continue
        u = u / length
        tensors[i] += occ[j] * u.reshape(3, 1) * u.reshape(1, 3)
        weights[i] += occ[j]
    total = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        if weights[i] > 0.0:
            tensor = tensors[i] / weights[i]
            anisotropy = 1.5 * (float(np.sum(tensor * tensor)) - 1.0 / 3.0)
            total += occ[i] * max(0.0, min(1.0, anisotropy))
            weight += occ[i]
    return float(total / weight) if weight > 0.0 else 0.0

features.description: Mean squared magnitude of the occupancy-weighted first-shell mean unit bond vector; measures directional imbalance independently of bond lengths and cell orientation.
features.name: local_bond_directional_imbalance
features.source:
def feature(s):
    sites = s.get('sites', ())
    n = len(sites)
    matrix = s.get('lattice', {}).get('matrix')
    if n == 0 or matrix is None or len(matrix) != 3:
        return 0.0
    lattice = np.asarray(matrix, dtype=float)
    occ = [max(0.0, float(t.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0)) for t in sites]
    nearest = [math.inf] * n
    neighbors = s.get('neighbors', ())
    for b in neighbors:
        d = b.get('distance_A')
        if d is not None and d > 0.0 and math.isfinite(d):
            i = b['i']
            if d < nearest[i]:
                nearest[i] = d
    vectors = np.zeros((n, 3))
    weights = [0.0] * n
    for b in neighbors:
        d = b.get('distance_A')
        i = b['i']
        j = b['j']
        if d is None or d <= 0.0 or not math.isfinite(d) or d > 1.25 * nearest[i] or occ[j] <= 0.0:
            continue
        fi = sites[i]['frac_coords']
        fj = sites[j]['frac_coords']
        image = b['image']
        delta = np.asarray([fj[k] + image[k] - fi[k] for k in range(3)], dtype=float)
        u = np.dot(delta, lattice)
        length = float(np.linalg.norm(u))
        if length <= 0.0 or not math.isfinite(length):
            continue
        vectors[i] += occ[j] * u / length
        weights[i] += occ[j]
    total = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        if weights[i] > 0.0:
            mean = vectors[i] / weights[i]
            imbalance = float(np.dot(mean, mean))
            total += occ[i] * max(0.0, min(1.0, imbalance))
            weight += occ[i]
    return float(total / weight) if weight > 0.0 else 0.0
